worldcombat.skill.jawlock.summary: Lunge in and bite down: both you and the target are pinned where you stand. The bite lands once, but neither can leave until one of you falls or something tears the pair apart. Vise locks longer and harder to shake but bites lighter; Snap bites harder and locks shorter.
worldcombat.skill.jawlock.use.0: Pin a key target until allies finish it
worldcombat.skill.jawlock.use.1: Trade your own mobility for the foe's
worldcombat.skill.jawlock.use.2: Stop a foe trying to flee or charge
worldcombat.skill.jawlock.description.0: The bite deals about %1$s damage and reaches a target within %2$s blocks; the target's defence, type and crit are settled on the hit.
worldcombat.skill.jawlock.description.1: Both are pinned for up to %1$s; the lock breaks if the pair separates beyond %2$s blocks or either one falls.
worldcombat.skill.jawlock.description.2: You step up to %1$s blocks to bite, throwing about %2$s chips; the caster is pinned too.
worldcombat.skill.jawlock.option.on: Vise: lock duration x1.25 and grip +0.4 blocks, much harder to tear off, but bite x0.9 and cooldown +8 ticks.
worldcombat.skill.jawlock.option.off: Snap: bite x1.1 at the base cooldown and a quicker hand, but the lock holds for less time.
worldcombat.skill.jawlock.timing: Bite reach %1$s blocks; windup %2$s, recovery %3$s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s from commit. While locked, neither the caster nor the target can move.
worldcombat.skill.jawlock.growth.0: At level %1$s the bite rises to %2$s power and the lock to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.jawlock.preference.vis: On (Vise): lock duration x1.25 and grip +0.4 blocks, much harder to tear off, but bite x0.9 and cooldown +8 ticks. Off (Snap): bite x1.1 at the base cooldown and a quicker hand, but the lock holds for less time.
Only commit while a threat is within this distance; lower keeps it point-blank, higher circles in before biting.
Do not commit below this health ratio (pinning yourself is a bad trade); set 0 to bite even when nearly down.
When on, the companion may leave its post to pin a target under a Hold order; off only bites what it can reach from where it stands.
